purpose: Defines how Adaptive Research separates implementation-specific knowledge from cross-lineage capabilities. Node capability outputs may satisfy optional capability requirements in research and other game systems without forcing a specific technological path.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Spacecraft Construction
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can construct substantial spacecraft rather than receiving them abstractly. Different shipbuilding traditions can satisfy this capability.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Orbital Industry
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can sustain manufacturing and assembly in orbit at the scale required for permanent infrastructure and early spacecraft.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Long-Duration Gravity Management
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: A viable method exists to manage long-duration gravity-related health/development needs for the relevant population.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Long-Duration Habitation
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: The relevant population can survive/sustain long missions through some viable life-support, torpor, biological, synthetic, or future implementation.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Megastructure Construction
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can fabricate and maintain structures at scales beyond conventional orbital facilities.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Experimental Interstellar Transit
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: A demonstrated but immature means of faster-than-light or equivalent interstellar transit exists.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Reliable Interstellar Transit
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization possesses at least one sufficiently reliable practical implementation for interstellar transit. Warp, stabilized wormholes, foreign/hybrid routes, and future secret routes can all satisfy this capability.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Extended Interstellar Transit
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization has improved practical interstellar reach/throughput beyond its first reliable implementation.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Interstellar Supply Network
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can support recurring logistics across interstellar distances.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Advanced Local Fabrication
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: A remote settlement, ship, or installation can manufacture a broad range of advanced components locally from suitable feedstock.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Food Independence
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: The relevant metabolic population can sustain nutrient/food needs without routine external biological supply; implementation depends on its biochemistry.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Biosphere Independence
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: A colony-scale ecological system can remain broadly self-sustaining without routine biological resupply.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Machine Long-Duration Habitation
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Synthetic populations can maintain persistent habitation over long missions/distant environments.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Hybrid Technology Development
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can deliberately combine different technological lineages into new native implementations.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Planetary Environment Transformation
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can deliberately transform a planetary environment at global scale.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Multi-Biochemistry Habitation Support
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: A habitat/colony can deliberately support multiple substantially different biochemical populations through separated or compatible environmental/life-support systems.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Cross-Biochemistry Medical Support
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can provide meaningful medical support for a target biochemical population despite major solvent/substrate differences, subject to target-specific understanding and facilities.

cross_lineage_capabilities.name: Cross-Biochemistry Biofabrication
cross_lineage_capabilities.description: Civilization can deliberately engineer/produce biological or bioindustrial systems across substantially different biochemical lineages rather than only its native biochemistry.

implications.description: Machine habitation satisfies generic long-duration habitation only for the compatible synthetic population/context.

schema_extension.semantics: All capabilities in all_of are required. If any_of is non-empty, at least one of those capabilities is required. Population-scoped capabilities must be present for the target population/context. Capability requirements are evaluated in addition to knowledge prerequisites, applicability, evidence, and explicit pressure gates.
